description: This file declares functions related to loading and freeing plugins for the bbfdm project, including internal, external, and dotso plugins.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_internal_plugin
methods.description: Loads an internal plugin given the context, dynamic object, and main entry point.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_external_plugin
methods.description: Loads an external plugin library given the context, library handle storage, and main entry point.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Loads a dotso plugin from a specified file path.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a loaded dotso plugin.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_json_plugin
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a JSON plugin, if applicable.
